title: dumpcap: clean up some error code stuff.
description:
Have capture_loop_init_output() consistently use global_ld.err to store
the error code from various write operations.

Have it also clear global_ld.err when it starts.

Have capture_file_start_output(), and the routines it calls, do so as
well; it already updates other elements of global_ld.

Clean up some comments while we're at it.

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
